rules.statement: The BIO commitment lasts at least four years and ends on 31 December 2028.

result.description: Start in 2023/2024/2025 creates a 6/5/4-year commitment ending 2028-12-31.

rules.statement: Obligations cover all agricultural holding area except alpine pasture and livestock, subject to documented part-holding and animal exceptions.

result.description: Whole-holding BIO scope is required.

rules.statement: Protected cultivation, nurseries, energy wood, other permanent crops, Silphie, elephant grass, gingko and aquaculture are not eligible BIO measure area.

conditions.expression: parcel.use is listed excluded special use

result.description: No BIO premium for the listed use.

rules.statement: A bio part holding requires separate facilities and land, separate crop sectors, and separate storage of inputs.

result.description: All separation requirements must be met.

rules.statement: The holding must be registered as organic and have an uninterrupted recognized control-body contract from 1 January of the first commitment year.

result.description: Control-body changes cannot have a temporal gap.

rules.statement: A holding is livestock-holding at at least 0.30 RGVE per hectare of forage area; the listed RGVE factors apply.

result.description: Below the threshold it is non-livestock-holding.

rules.statement: BIO input purchasing, storage and use and livestock rules under Regulation (EU) 2018/848 apply; no conventional livestock subholding is allowed.

result.description: Only two non-certified fattening pigs and ten non-certified chickens for own use, and conventional equids under the stated separation rule, are exceptions.

rules.statement: From application year 2026, plant-protection use no longer needs to be coded in the multiple application.

result.description: PSM coding duty ceases.

rules.statement: Maintain reference grassland; no more than 1.00 ha may be converted to arable, permanent/special crop, wine or protected cultivation during commitment.

result.description: New grassland can refill tolerance; same-application internal swaps count, inter-holding swaps do not.

rules.statement: Above 5 ha arable land, cereal plus maize may be no more than 75% and each non-exempt crop no more than 55% of arable area.

conditions.description: Whole holding arable area is denominator.

result.description: Forage crops, and from 2025 fallow and asparagus, are exempt from the 55% limit.

rules.statement: By 2025-12-31, 3 biodiversity and 5 organic-farming hours from a recognized provider are required; courses from 2022 count.

result.description: The trained person may be a materially involved holding person; duplicate credit is prohibited.

rules.statement: Above 2 ha arable land, at least 7% of arable area must be biodiversity or creditable area.

conditions.description: GLÖZ landscape elements and multi-benefit hedges are excluded from the denominator.

result.description: Holdings below 10 ha arable may satisfy it with qualifying additional grassland biodiversity area.

rules.statement: At holdings with at least 10 ha arable area, each arable field piece over 5 ha needs at least 0.15 ha biodiversity/creditable area.

result.description: Allocated GLÖZ elements and, from 2025, agroforestry strips count only for this 0.15-ha test.

rules.statement: NAT/EBW arable fallow, eligible multi-benefit hedge herb zone, BAW/AG, GLÖZ 4 and until 2024 GLÖZ 8 may count only with DIV and their stated management conditions; K20 arable does not count.

result.description: Project confirmation management remains controlling.

rules.statement: New arable DIV sowing needs at least seven insect-flowering partners from three families and at most 10% non-insect-flowering partners.

conditions.description: Existing stated legacy areas are excepted.

result.description: Sow by 15 May.

rules.statement: Arable biodiversity areas stay in the same location for two application years; tillage is only from 15 September of year two, or 31 July for winter crop/intercrop.

result.description: Fallow biodiversity land has a use ban through 31 December after tillage.

rules.statement: From 2025 DIV must be mown, mulched or grazed at least once every two years and no more than twice yearly; 75% may not be used before 1 August and grazing is never before 1 August.

result.description: Drilling is prohibited; documented invasive weeds and first-year cleaning cut are specified exceptions.

rules.statement: No fertilizer may be used from 1 January of first DIV declaration until tillage/other declaration; removal is mechanical only, and driving/storage/turning on DIV is prohibited.

result.description: Biodiversity parcel protection.

rules.statement: DIVRS requires regional seed with at least 30 species from seven families, ≥20 kg/ha, ≤5% each species and origin evidence; certified ecotype seed may depart from the list and 5% cap.

result.description: Seed labels, invoices and certification must document the mixture; current management has mowing or green-fallow alternatives.

rules.statement: Above 2 ha mown grassland excluding mountain meadows, at least 7% must be grassland biodiversity or creditable area.

result.description: Below 2 ha, voluntary biodiversity land may receive base and supplements.

rules.statement: At at least 10 ha mown grassland, field pieces over 5 ha mown area need 0.15 ha biodiversity/creditable area; GLÖZ elements count only for that field-piece test.

result.description: NAT, EBW and N2 count only where prescribed grassland/scheduled-use conditions are met.

rules.statement: Each grassland biodiversity variant requires at least one annual mowing with removal; DIVSZ, DIVNFZ, DIVAGF and DIVRS have their respective date, rest-period, access and fertilization rules.

result.description: DIVSZ: earliest 15 June/join comparable second cut; DIVNFZ: nine weeks without use; DIVAGF: final use by 15 August then next year DIVSZ.

rules.statement: Grassland DIVRS requires ≥30 regional-list species from seven families, ≥20 kg/ha, grassland score ≥30, slope under 18%, sowing by 15 May and only manure/compost fertilizer exception.

result.description: Maximum two uses, first no earlier than 15 July, mowing/removal required and mulching prohibited.

rules.statement: Eligible point landscape elements are controlled trees/bushes/groups within or up to 5 m adjacent, crown diameter ≥2 m, max 100 m² and ≥5 m apart, retained all year.

result.description: No alpine/hut pasture and no GLÖZ landscape elements; at most 80 per ha field piece.

rules.statement: A multi-benefit hedge must meet location, 2023-to-15-May establishment, official concept/layer, 5–20 m width, 20% permanent herb zone and no input/use rules.

result.description: EU-organic permitted browsing protection is allowed.

rules.statement: Bio bee premium is for certified economic colonies only and excludes relevant beekeeping-sector support; monitoring requires confirmation, introduction and annual complete data; the EUR 400 transaction amount applies automatically from 2025.

result.description: Monitoring programme-specific NAT requirements apply.

rules.statement: Extra arable biodiversity support is only above 7% and up to 20%; Ackerzahl ≥50 and one DIV parcel >0.05 ha per commenced 3 ha have further supplements.

result.description: Credited other-measure/GLÖZ4 area does not qualify for the above-7% supplement.

rules.statement: Rare regional varieties must be pure variety from the closed list and documented; support is at most 10 ha per variety and once per area/year.

result.description: For perennial crops, payment and SLK application are only in first use year.

rules.statement: Supported arable crops receive an increment only if their total share exceeds 15%, with at most 40% of arable area paid and higher-rate crops prioritized.

result.description: Eligible groups include forage, listed legumes, oilseed group, sunflower, BHG/autochthonous seed.

rules.statement: Wild herb/breeding area is cereal sown at ≥20 cm double row spacing without undersowing, with no driving, fertilizer, pesticide or mechanical weed control 15 March–30 June/drilling.

result.description: Summer cereal must be sown by 15 March; only drilling harvest through 30 June.

rules.statement: From 2025, sugar-beet pheromone supplement requires ≥15 traps/ha, placement within 14 days, five weeks retained, at least two emptyings, removal before harvest and records/evidence.

result.description: On destruction, document; retain/reinstall following beet, otherwise fulfill obligations before claiming.

rules.statement: From 2025, circular-economy supplement requires listed crop area over 15% of arable and annual density under 1.40 RGVE/ha; grassland additionally needs livestock-holder status and over 8% biodiversity/species-rich grassland.

result.description: No separate application when criteria and crop declarations exist.

rules.statement: BIO entry required the measure application by 31 December before entry (last 2025); specified measure combinations are excluded, and parcel codes apply to each option.

result.description: Part-holding BIO parcels use BIO; DIV/DIVRS, grassland DIV codes, SLK, BHG, WB, SO and PZR have stated declaration rules.

rules.statement: 2026 base and supplement rates apply as set out in the 2026 premium table, with stated 20% caps and payment-combination restrictions.

result.description: Rego exposes principal 2026 rates; all payments remain subject to general caps and modulation.

rules.statement: First participation requires 1.50 ha total agricultural area or 0.50 ha protected cultivation, and eligible land must be in Austria, actively farmed and meet minimum management unless a BIO exception applies.

result.description: National park, OP and non-eligible-area qualifications apply.

rules.statement: Area losses, access limits, annual obligation, controls, reductions and repayment follow the general participation rules.

result.description: 2026 drought exceptions preserve stated BIO payments only where their OP coding and special conditions are met.
